title: Overpass
notes: DRAFT. Generated by tools/m8_overpass.py from tools/songs/op.py and tools/songs/instruments.py; see docs/songs/overpass-parts.md and overpass-instruments.md. Every element carries the walkthrough step that introduces it (and `until`, the last step it belongs to).

90.about: One note per track, all four on instrument 0A at the same moment. The envelope lets each ring out over the bar.

10.about: Beat 1 and the “and” of 3. Nothing on beat 3: that gap is the skip.

30.about: Closed hat on the even rows (off-beat eighths loud), shaker on the odd rows (the swung ones), very quiet. Velocity does the work.

40.about: Root with the kick, a swung repeat, an octave pop. Short notes; the rests are part of the line.

50.about: A-3 plays the Cm9 render three semitones down: C G B E, Am9 without its root.

52.about: D-4: the same render two semitones up, F C E A.

56.about: Instrument 08, the Cmaj9 render, seven semitones down: A E G C.

5D.about: 05's own envelope is a short stab; DE1 lengthens it for this note only (settings sheet).

60.about: Written as typed. C-4 plays your hummed C at its own pitch; hum it at C5 and the whole hook sounds an octave above what is written here (E5 to A5, the plan's register).

8F.about: The filter stays where it was put.

FD.about: Shared: an OFF on row 0 stops whatever the track was playing.
